description.it: Classifica attuale della competizione scelta e andamento delle posizioni tra gli import.
description.en: Current table of the chosen competition and positions across imports.

widgets.sql: SELECT r.position, r.club_name, r.played, r.won, r.drawn, r.lost, r.goals_for, r.goals_against, r.goals_for - r.goals_against AS goal_difference, r.points FROM LeagueTable lt JOIN LeagueTableRow r ON r._parent_rid = lt._rid WHERE lt.competition_id = :competition ORDER BY lt._rid, r.position

title.it: Posizione a ogni import (le prime 6 di oggi)

widgets.sql: SELECT i.game_date AS date, r.club_name AS series, r.position AS value FROM LeagueTable_all lt JOIN LeagueTableRow_all r ON r._parent_rid = lt._rid JOIN _imports i ON i.import_id = lt._import_id WHERE lt.competition_id = :competition AND r.club_uid IN (SELECT r2.club_uid FROM LeagueTable lt2 JOIN LeagueTableRow r2 ON r2._parent_rid = lt2._rid WHERE lt2.competition_id = :competition ORDER BY r2.position LIMIT 6) ORDER BY date
SELECT r.club_name, r.goals_for, r.goals_against FROM LeagueTable lt JOIN LeagueTableRow r ON r._parent_rid = lt._rid WHERE lt.competition_id = :competition ORDER BY r.position
